summary: Iteration 106 — Sponsored Clips + Smart Location news + Home empty-state doctrine + Light theme on /trivia and /predict-win — ALL 7 acceptance criteria PASS on both backend (pytest 11/11) and web frontend (demo@bigfm.dubai, viewport 1440x900). GET /api/shell/clips returns 11 items: first is a REAL sponsored clip from an active campaign (id=camp_cmp_dr_mehta_appt, business_id=biz_dr_mehta_jlt, title='Free dental check-up', channel='Dr. Mehta', sponsored=true, image=null → ClipCard9x16 renders electric-magenta gradient fallback with visible 'SPONSORED' badge — expected per main-agent doc note a); remaining 10 clips are live AI channels (sponsored=false, all with cover art). Home shelves gate on content (home-venues + home-clips + home-news render only when non-empty; home-venues-empty NOT present in default feed). GET /api/news/headlines?market=dfw is fired from Home (Smart Location resolved user to DFW/Dallas via geo bootstrap, single geo source via useGeoStore). Light-theme CSS vars propagate cleanly on both /predict-win and /trivia: body bg rgb(255,255,255), text rgb(11,11,18), cards rgb(245,246,248) — legible; DARK still correct after toggle. iter105 regression: /api/shell/venues still sponsored-first + category filter works.

issues: Minor / OUT-OF-SCOPE per main-agent note c: the 'Earn 100 BigPoints per friend' pill (BannerSlot house ad) and the top 'Premium — 7-day free trial' AD banner render very pale on the new white bg — low contrast. Both are BannerSlot/AD components, NOT PredictWin.jsx theme code, so out of scope for this iteration. Flagged so it isn't lost in the next iteration.

critical_code_review_comments: backend/routes/shell.py:212 — `return {"items": clips[:limit + 1], "count": len(clips)}` slices `limit + 1` (11 when limit=10) but the docstring implies `limit` clips. This is intentional (sponsored clip is 'extra') but the slicing off-by-one is subtle; recommend either (a) documenting the +1 in the docstring or (b) fetching `.limit(limit)` on channels and using `clips[:limit]`. Also `count` counts sponsored + all fetched channels (up to `limit` channels), which mismatches the slice; minor cosmetic inconsistency.

backend/routes/shell.py:179 — Only picks ONE campaign (sort by created_at desc). If that most-recent 'active' campaign lacks a business_id / marketplace_profile, the sponsored clip will have no image. Currently the case for `cmp_dr_mehta_appt` (biz_dr_mehta_jlt is not in marketplace_profiles). The frontend gradient-fallback covers this, but consider preferring campaigns whose business_id resolves to a profile with a cover_url so the sponsored slot always shows real art.

frontend/src/Home.jsx:40-52 — News fetch depends only on [user, market]. Good — no double-fetch on chip changes. However the request fires 3× on my browser session (captured 3 identical calls to /api/news/headlines?limit=6&market=dfw) — likely due to store re-hydration cycling `market` from 'global' → cache → resolved 'dfw'. Not a bug, but each cycle re-queries; consider debouncing or gating on `useGeoStore((s)=>s.ready)`.
frontend/src/Home.jsx:75 — `chipLabel` uses .find() on every render; safe here (small array) but consider useMemo if summary.chips ever grows.

frontend/src/shell/cards.jsx:89 ClipCard9x16 — the Sponsored badge text is 9px + uppercase + wide letter-spacing on a black/70 pill; on the gradient fallback it's readable (the accent-electric colour pops), but on some cover images (dark low-contrast frames) the badge could be lost. Consider adding a slight backdrop-blur or increasing bg opacity to bg-black/85 for readability.
backend/routes/shell.py — file now at ~213 lines, still under the 700-line threshold. Fine for now.
